Whether you need to learn lists of information, or for instance, every muscle and bone in the human body including how they function together, there is a method really works to help you out. The bonus is that this method doesn't stress you out either because you get to take lots of breaks.

My Pregnancy Calculator is a simple to use application to determine the milestones of your pregnancy. By just recording the first date of your last menstrual period, the average number of days in your menstrual cycle and with a click of a button, the questions above will be answered.

You can also work backward if you only know your expected date of delivery as in the case when you have forgotten the date of your last menstrual period or your periods are very irregular and the expected date of delivery has to be determined by ultrasonography.

Other features:

1.The app is password protected.
